sentences.cn_text: 科学论文是研究进展的记录载体。
sentences.en_text: Scientific papers are the recordkeepers of progress in research.

sentences.cn_text: 研究人员每年在超过30,000种期刊上发表数百万篇论文。
sentences.en_text: Each year researchers publish millions of papers in more than 30,000 journals.

sentences.cn_text: 科学界通过多种方式衡量这些论文的质量,包括期刊的公认质量(体现为该期刊的影响因子)以及特定论文所积累的引用次数。
sentences.en_text: The scientific community measures the quality of those papers in a number of ways, including the perceived quality of the journal (as reflected by the title’s impact factor) and the number of citations a specific paper accumulates.

sentences.cn_text: 科学家的职业发展和所在机构的声誉取决于其发表论文的数量和声望,但更取决于这些论文所获得的引用次数。
sentences.en_text: The careers of scientists and the reputation of their institutions depend on the number and prestige of the papers they produce, but even more so on the citations attracted by these papers.

sentences.cn_text: 引用联盟,即期刊、作者和机构共谋虚增引用数量的行为,已存在很长时间。
sentences.en_text: Citation cartels, where journals, authors, and institutions conspire to inflate citation numbers, have existed for a long time.

sentences.cn_text: 2016年,研究人员开发了一种算法来识别可疑的引用模式,包括作者群体之间的不成比例相互引用,以及期刊群体之间通过频繁相互引用来提高其出版物影响因子的行为。
sentences.en_text: In 2016, researchers developed an algorithm to recognize suspicious citation patterns, including groups of authors that disproportionately cite one another and groups of journals that cite each other frequently to increase the impact factors of their publications.

sentences.cn_text: 近来,这种掠夺性行为出现了新的表现形式:所谓的支持服务咨询机构为个别作者和期刊提供语言及其他编辑支持,有时会建议投稿者在其文章中添加若干引用。
sentences.en_text: Recently, another expression of this predatory behavior has emerged: so-called support service consultancies that provide language and other editorial support to individual authors and to journals sometimes advise contributors to add a number of citations to their articles.

sentences.cn_text: 电子出版的兴起以及作者寻找论文发表平台的需求催生了数千种新期刊。
sentences.en_text: The advent of electronic publishing and authors’ need to find outlets for their papers resulted in thousands of new journals.

sentences.cn_text: 掠夺性期刊的出现紧随其后。
sentences.en_text: The birth of predatory journals wasn’t far behind.

sentences.cn_text: 这些期刊可充当引用工具,某一期中的每篇文章都可能引用某篇特定论文或一系列论文。
sentences.en_text: These journals can act as milk cows where every single article in an issue may cite a specific paper or a series of papers.

sentences.cn_text: 在某些情况下,文章内容与所引文献之间毫无关联。
sentences.en_text: In some instances, there is absolutely no relationship between the content of the article and the citations.

sentences.cn_text: 奇怪之处在于,编辑名义上服务的期刊本身并未从中获利——它只是为其他期刊提供引用。
sentences.en_text: The peculiar part is that the journal that the editor is supposedly working for is not profiting at all — it is just providing citations to other journals.

sentences.cn_text: 这种做法可使一篇文章在发表当年就累积超过150次引用。
sentences.en_text: Such practices can lead an article to accrue more than 150 citations in the same year that it was published.

sentences.cn_text: 这类引用操纵有多隐蔽?
sentences.en_text: How insidious is this type of citation manipulation?

sentences.cn_text: 在一个案例中,某个人同时担任作者、编辑和顾问,能够利用至少15种期刊为三所大学五位科学家发表的文章提供引用。
sentences.en_text: In one example, an individual — acting as author, editor, and consultant — was able to use at least 15 journals as citation providers to articles published by five scientists at three universities.

sentences.cn_text: 这一问题在引文数据库Scopus中十分猖獗,该数据库收录了大量新的「国际」期刊。
sentences.en_text: The problem is rampant in Scopus, a citation database, which includes a high number of the new “international” journals.

sentences.cn_text: 事实上,被Scopus收录似乎成为这类引用操纵的目标标准。
sentences.en_text: In fact, a listing in Scopus seems to be a criterion to be targeted in this type of citation manipulation.

sentences.cn_text: Scopus本身拥有检测此类不当行为所需的全部数据。
sentences.en_text: Scopus itself has all the data necessary to detect this malpractice.

sentences.cn_text: 警示信号包括某篇文章在发表第一年内就获得大量引用。
sentences.en_text: Red flags include a large number of citations to an article within the first year.

sentences.cn_text: 对于希望避开引用联盟活动的作者而言:当编辑、审稿人或支持服务机构要求您添加不当引用时,切勿照做,并应向期刊举报这一要求。
sentences.en_text: And for authors who wish to steer clear of citation cartel activities: when an editor, a reviewer, or a support service asks you to add inappropriate references, do not oblige and do report the request to the journal.

sentences.cn_text: 根据第一段,科学家的职业发展可由____决定。
sentences.en_text: According to Paragraph 1, the careers of scientists can be determined by ____

sentences.cn_text: 其作品包含多少引用
sentences.en_text: how many citations their works contain.

sentences.cn_text: 其论文被引用的次数
sentences.en_text: how many times their papers are cited.

sentences.cn_text: 其合作者的声望
sentences.en_text: the prestige of the people they work with.

sentences.cn_text: 其在科学界的地位
sentences.en_text: the status they have in scientific circles.

sentences.cn_text: 支持服务咨询机构往往会____
sentences.en_text: The support service consultancies tend to ____

sentences.cn_text: 向客户推荐期刊
sentences.en_text: recommend journals to their clients.

sentences.cn_text: 为客户列出引用模式
sentences.en_text: list citation patterns for their clients.

sentences.cn_text: 要求作者添加额外引用
sentences.en_text: ask authors to include extra citations.

sentences.cn_text: 建议投稿者相互引用
sentences.en_text: advise contributors to cite each other.

sentences.cn_text: 「引用工具」期刊的作用是____
sentences.en_text: The function of the “milk cow” journals is to ____

sentences.cn_text: 提升特定作者的引用次数
sentences.en_text: boost citation counts for certain authors.

sentences.cn_text: 帮助学者低成本发表文章
sentences.en_text: help scholars publish articles at low cost.

sentences.cn_text: 指导首次投稿者进行引用
sentences.en_text: instruct first-time contributors in citation.

sentences.cn_text: 增加新期刊的读者群
sentences.en_text: increase the readership of new journals.

sentences.cn_text: 从最后两段可以了解到关于Scopus的什么信息?
sentences.en_text: What can be learned about Scopus from the last two paragraphs?

sentences.cn_text: 它促进引文提供者之间的竞争
sentences.en_text: It fosters competition among citation providers.

sentences.cn_text: 它有能力识别可疑引用
sentences.en_text: It has the capability to identify suspicious citations.

sentences.cn_text: 它阻碍「国际」期刊的发展
sentences.en_text: It hinders the growth of “international” journals.

sentences.cn_text: 它的建立旨在防止引用操纵
sentences.en_text: It is established to prevent citation manipulation.

sentences.cn_text: 作者应如何应对引用操纵者?
sentences.en_text: What should an author do to deal with citation manipulators?

sentences.cn_text: 采取法律行动
sentences.en_text: Take legal action.

sentences.cn_text: 要求道歉
sentences.en_text: Demand an apology.

sentences.cn_text: 寻求专业建议
sentences.en_text: Seek professional advice.

sentences.cn_text: 揭露其不当行为
sentences.en_text: Reveal their misconduct.
